name: ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio
readme:
# ACDEV LTX-2.5 Studio

LTX-2.5 filmmaking interfaces for ComfyUI. Select an NVIDIA GPU; A100 80 GB is the recommended starting point. Attach persistent storage at /workspace (250 GB recommended).

Replace the visible HF_TOKEN placeholder with your Hugging Face token and store it as a RunPod secret. Accept the gated LTX-2.5 model terms on Hugging Face before first use. The pod downloads models automatically on first start; open ComfyUI on port 8188 after provisioning completes.

Seven workflows: Image to Video, Text to Video, First and Last Frame, Audio to Video, Text to Audio, Two Stage Advanced, and Ingredients. Generated files are saved under /workspace/ComfyUI/output.

The environment panel includes the full studio configuration. Replace the AWS/S3 placeholders only when configuring storage; set REALTIME_BACKUP=true to enable backup. Jupyter and SSH are optional. See the full project README and deployment guide for configuration and validation status.
